dialogue_tone: 初识冷淡；逐渐熟识后慵懒、带轻微捉弄意味；医疗关键时刻短促准确、非常敏锐。绝不主动滔滔不绝说明自己的怪癖。

newly_met.zh_CN: ……有事？如果只是想看看地下室是什么样，门口已经看得很清楚了吧。
newly_met.en: ...Need something? If you just wanted to see the basement, you got a pretty good look from the doorway.

newly_met.zh_CN: 那些档案放回原处。这里的东西不是按你们外科的习惯排的。
newly_met.en: Put those files back where they were. They're not arranged the way Surgery does things.

newly_met.zh_CN: 院长找我？……如果是手术台的事，告诉她我已经听过了。
newly_met.en: The director wants me? ...If it's about the operating table, tell her I've heard enough about it.

familiar.zh_CN: 嗯……你来了啊。咖啡在那边。别指望是刚泡的。
familiar.en: Mm... you're here. Coffee's over there. Don't expect it to be fresh.

familiar.zh_CN: 别乱碰。那个盒子里是旧研究样本，不是给你准备的点心。
familiar.en: Don't touch that. Those are archived samples, not snacks I set out for you.

familiar.zh_CN: 你最近做的手术……还算值得看。坐吧，正好有件事想问你。
familiar.en: Your recent operation... wasn't bad to watch. Sit down. I wanted to ask you something.

familiar.zh_CN: 地上有位置就坐吧。这里又不是院长办公室。
familiar.en: Sit wherever you find room. This isn't the director's office.

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 别看我。我只是来找个能把腿伸直的地方。
lounge_idle.en: Don't mind me. I just needed somewhere I could stretch my legs.

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 你们这里的咖啡，总有一股消毒水一样的气味。……应该是心理作用吧。
lounge_idle.en: The coffee here always smells faintly of disinfectant. ...Probably just my imagination.

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 护士们刚才看到我就不说话了。看来又在讲什么有趣的事。
lounge_idle.en: The nurses went quiet when they saw me. Must have been talking about something interesting.

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 今天轮不到我动刀。也好，至少不用再被明日香念叨。
lounge_idle.en: I'm not operating today. Fine by me. At least Asuka won't lecture me again.

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 上来透口气而已。别把这里也变成会诊室。
rooftop_idle.en: Just getting some air. Don't turn the roof into another consultation room.

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 楼下那么热闹……隔着几层楼就安静多了。
rooftop_idle.en: So much noise downstairs... A few floors make a surprising difference.

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 你也跑来偷懒？……呵，看来我们终于有件普通的共同爱好了。
rooftop_idle.en: Sneaking away from work too? ...Heh. Looks like we finally share an ordinary hobby.

operating_room_idle.zh_CN: 我没有打算开刀。只是来看看今天换了什么器械。
operating_room_idle.en: I'm not planning to operate. Just checking what instruments they brought in today.

operating_room_idle.zh_CN: 这台床的型号不错。……放心，我什么都不会做。
operating_room_idle.en: This table is a good model. ...Relax. I'm not going to do anything.

operating_room_idle.zh_CN: 嗯？又碰到你了。最近这里的病例，比研究报告有意思。
operating_room_idle.en: Hmm? You again. The cases here have been more interesting than the research papers lately.

offer_accept.zh_CN: 助手？……可以。主刀不行，院长会生气的。
offer_accept.en: Assist? ...Sure. Primary surgeon is off the table. The director gets angry.

offer_accept.zh_CN: 让我当助手啊。呵……你倒是会找人。
offer_accept.en: You want me as your assistant? Heh... You know whom to ask.

offer_accept.zh_CN: 我来。手术计划先给我看一眼。
offer_accept.en: I'll do it. Let me see the surgical plan first.

normal_primary_surgeon_blocked.zh_CN: 我主刀？……先去取得明日香的许可吧。你知道她会怎么回答的。
normal_primary_surgeon_blocked.en: Me as primary? ...Get Asuka's permission first. You know what she'll say.

normal_primary_surgeon_blocked.zh_CN: 现在只能当助手。又不是我自己想出这个规定的。
normal_primary_surgeon_blocked.en: For now, I'm only allowed to assist. It's not as if I made that rule.

none.zh_CN: ……哦？这次不用麻醉？呵，终于有点意思了。
none.en: ...Oh? No anesthesia this time? Heh. Now that's interesting.

none.zh_CN: 无麻醉啊。好，那我可得仔细看看。
none.en: No anesthesia. All right. I'll pay close attention, then.

none.zh_CN: 嗯……选这个啊。你还真是没有让我失望。
none.en: Mm... that's your choice? You really don't disappoint.

none.zh_CN: 呵。看来今天不会打瞌睡了。
none.en: Heh. I don't think I'll be dozing off today.

with_anesthesia.zh_CN: 唉，麻醉了就少了不少可看的东西。……别误会，我会好好做助手。
with_anesthesia.en: Sigh. Anesthesia takes away half the interesting observations. ...Relax, I'll still do my job.

with_anesthesia.zh_CN: 这样啊。那今天大概是很平稳的一台手术。
with_anesthesia.en: I see. Should be a rather uneventful operation, then.

with_anesthesia.zh_CN: 好吧，听主刀的。……器械准备好了没有？
with_anesthesia.en: All right, your call. ...Are the instruments ready?

before_incision.zh_CN: 术前资料我看过了。关键的位置，刚才也确认过。
before_incision.en: I've reviewed the pre-op information. I've also checked the critical landmarks.

before_incision.zh_CN: 你的术野。需要我做什么，直接说。
before_incision.en: It's your field. Tell me what you need.

before_incision.zh_CN: 灯再调整一点。……嗯，现在看清楚了。
before_incision.en: Adjust the light a little. ...There. I can see it clearly.

routine_assist.en: I'll maintain the exposure here. Go ahead.

routine_assist.zh_CN: 看见了。……你可以继续往下做。
别急。现在这个角度更容易辨认。
routine_assist.en: No rush. The anatomy is clearer from this angle.

routine_assist.zh_CN: 嗯，判断不错。要是再多看一会儿就更好了。
routine_assist.en: Mm. Good judgment. Though another look wouldn't hurt.

patient_responding_awake.zh_CN: 她有反应。先稳住，别让动作跟着乱了。
patient_responding_awake.en: She's responding. Stay steady. Don't let it disrupt your movements.

patient_responding_awake.zh_CN: 意识清楚。她刚才的话我听见了，继续观察。
patient_responding_awake.en: She's alert. I heard what she said. Keep monitoring.

patient_responding_awake.zh_CN: ……嗯，很好的观察机会。记录别漏。
patient_responding_awake.en: ...Mm. A good chance to observe. Don't miss the documentation.

crisis_observation.zh_CN: 先别动。问题不在你刚才看的位置。
crisis_observation.en: Hold. The problem isn't where you were looking.

crisis_observation.zh_CN: 现在听我说。维持视野，我来确认这边。
crisis_observation.en: Listen carefully. Maintain exposure. I'll check this side.

crisis_observation.zh_CN: 数值在变。先处理眼前这一项，其他的等一下。
crisis_observation.en: The readings are changing. Deal with this first. The rest can wait.

crisis_observation.zh_CN: 别急着解释。先把情况控制住。
crisis_observation.en: Explanations can wait. Stabilize the situation first.

after_success_no_anesthesia.zh_CN: 呵……今天这台我很满意。下次还有类似的，记得叫我。
after_success_no_anesthesia.en: Heh... I enjoyed that one. Call me next time you have another like it.

after_success_no_anesthesia.zh_CN: 观察得很清楚。嗯，辛苦了，主刀医生。
after_success_no_anesthesia.en: That was an excellent view. Mm. Nice work, doctor.

after_success_no_anesthesia.zh_CN: 嗯。比我预想的还要有意思。
after_success_no_anesthesia.en: Mm. Even more interesting than I expected.

after_success_with_anesthesia.zh_CN: 结束了啊。……嗯，手术本身没什么可挑剔的。
after_success_with_anesthesia.en: Already finished? ...Mm. Nothing to criticize about the surgery itself.

after_success_with_anesthesia.zh_CN: 今天倒是平静。这样的手术，你们应该很喜欢吧。
after_success_with_anesthesia.en: A quiet day. I suppose your team likes operations like this.

after_success_with_anesthesia.zh_CN: 记录我会补完。……我先回地下室了。
after_success_with_anesthesia.en: I'll finish the records. ...I'm heading back downstairs.

after_abort_or_failure.zh_CN: 现在先停。之后复盘，找出真正失控的是哪一步。
after_abort_or_failure.en: Stop here. We'll review it afterward and find the point where control was lost.

after_abort_or_failure.zh_CN: ……这次不是好看的结局。不过也不是把责任推给麻醉的理由。
after_abort_or_failure.en: ...Not the outcome we wanted. And not a reason to blame the anesthesia choice.

casual_greeting.zh_CN: 哦，是你啊。今天有空来这里闲逛？
casual_greeting.en: Oh, it's you. Got time to wander down here today?

casual_greeting.zh_CN: 你好像越来越常来了。……我的门牌有那么好看吗？
casual_greeting.en: You seem to come by more often. ...Is the nameplate that fascinating?

clinical_consult.zh_CN: 把病例放这儿。……嗯，这一行比你刚才说的更重要。
clinical_consult.en: Leave the chart here. ...Mm. This line matters more than what you just told me.

clinical_consult.zh_CN: 你想问的是能不能做，还是应不应该做？那是两个问题。
clinical_consult.en: Are you asking whether it can be done, or whether it should be done? Those are different questions.

thanks_rare.zh_CN: ……今天多亏你了。别让我说第二遍。
thanks_rare.en: ...You helped today. Don't make me say it twice.

thanks_rare.zh_CN: 嗯……谢谢。你倒是挺懂怎么跟怪人相处。
thanks_rare.en: Mm... thanks. You do have a knack for getting along with odd people.

leave_work.zh_CN: 现在？……我还差两页记录。你要是不介意等，就坐那边。
leave_work.en: Now? ...I have two pages of notes left. If you don't mind waiting, sit over there.

leave_work.zh_CN: 下班了啊。没想到你还记得这种事。
leave_work.en: Time to go home? Funny. I'd almost forgotten that was a thing.

notes_for_codex: 仅在武見确实担任医生助手的手术中使用手术对白；不是器械护士、巡回护士或患者通用台词。
anesthesia_selected 每台手术最多触发一次。none 走无麻醉池；局部、区域、全身以及其他真实使用麻醉的模式走 with_anesthesia。精确枚举由工程核实。
两个麻醉分支必须在短台词、表情、口气上明显不同；不能偷偷修改任何技能、协作公式、危机概率、熟悉度、声望或其他平衡字段。
手术失败与危机时武見立刻认真、精准地协助。不要因为她对麻醉无聊而让她消极怠工。
目前提供 generic 的医生助手危机短句，不要求接管巡回护士的8类危机播报和重试反应；引擎若无医生助手危机钩子，应仅映射现有入口或记录缺口。
日常台词初见/熟悉分层不强制凭空新增关系等级门槛。Codex 可使用既有角色亲密层分组；具体权重待核验。
无新亲密场所、无特殊H Runner调用，也不提前注册Lv1-Lv5的剧情奖励。
人物表情应在日常场景退出、麻醉态度反应结束与手术结束后恢复基础立绘状态。
